roles.title: Principal Product Manager, Physical AI Applications (Retail & 3PL)

bullets: Own application and developer-interface product strategy, roadmaps, PRDs, and specifications for Retail and 3PL growth
Segment markets by customer, workflow, need, buying readiness, economics, and product fit to focus product and GTM investment
Lead outbound discovery with customers, prospects, operators, executives, integrators, and partners to uncover needs, buying barriers, willingness to pay, and differentiated value
Convert evidence into vertical-growth roadmaps across capabilities, integrations, proof points, reference solutions, and ecosystem needs; distinguish repeatable needs from…
Set entitlement, throughput, availability, reliability, adoption, and business-value targets and hold the product to dated proof gates
